name: Longshot (Ocarina of Time, Switch 2)
by: MagicBeanDev (git.magicbean.dev), a fork of NotRexed's Hookshot
about: The Switch 2 edition of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as a native PC game, recompiled from your own copy, with no emulator: Hookshot's recompilation where every change is played on real hardware before it goes in (dark blue nights as on the Switch 2, AMD's terrain fix kept on). Cartridge builds it from your copy in the background the first time (it downloads its build tools, then builds: 10 to 45 minutes, about 60 GB free while it builds), then starts it straight away. Needs Vulkan 1.3 and 16 GB of memory.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
